**Historically (all‑time)**  
The Los Angeles Lakers’ all‑time leading scorer is **Kareem Abdul‑Jabbar**, who amassed **2,647 points** during his 14‑season stint with the franchise (1975‑1989).

**Currently (2025‑26 season)**  
The team’s leading scorer for the ongoing season is **LeBron James**, averaging about **27.5 points per game** (as of the latest box‑scores). If you’re looking for the most recent game‑by‑game leader or a different time frame, let me know!
